Class SocketServerHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.network.socket.client.SocketServerHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServer, Remote
public class SocketServerHandler extends Object implements VirtualServer
The SocketServerHandler class acts as a client-side proxy for the server in a socket-based communication. It implements the VirtualServer interface, allowing the client to invoke "remote" methods that are then serialized as command objects and sent to the actual server via an ObjectOutputStream. This class handles the serialization and sending of various client-to-server messages.
